items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: Son Johnson was playing with him [Sidney Cate]. And I remember quite a bit about Son because of the fact that he also played with this WPA band that was organized in 19, just after Prohibition.

ctx.x: He's about the best alto sax around there now. No I don't know. He plays clarinet too.
Oh he plays clarinet too. I can't think. Well did you meet Son Johnson in New Orleans? I can't think.
